text:
rebecca: opening a small PR to tidy the Function/Tool calling docs. goal: replace noisy full dumps with compact envelopes in quickstarts and add a single full-output appendix for debugging. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2107
nate: nice. please keep one canonical full example in appendix so ops/debugging can see every field.
oli: spotted a broken anchor from the migration guide -> appendices. include that link fix in the PR.
rebecca: yep will patch anchors. plan: update docs/functions/invoke.md to use 2-line compact envelope examples, create docs/appendix/structured-output-full.md, and update snippets/python/invoke_quickstart.md and snippets/js/invoke_compact.md. also adding a tiny fallback snippet for raw_text parsing.
tara: ops note: current runtime emits `invocation` for newer models; older SDKs show `tool_call`. docs should show `invocation` as canonical and call out `tool_call` as legacy in a short compat blurb at the top.
docs-ci: reminder: add CHANGELOG entry and mark PR docs-only. also suggest adding a grep test that ensures invoke snippets include either `compact` or `raw_text` so examples don't regress.
rebecca: agreed on the CI lint. i'll add a small grep + exit rule to docs CI and list it in PR description.
nate: fallback snippet idea (py):
```python
resp = client.invoke(...)
out = resp['output'].get('compact')
if not out:
    out = resp['output'].get('raw_text', '')
    # best-effort parse of unstructured text
```
oli: short line under snippet: "Prefer `compact` for deterministic parsing; `raw_text` is a fallback for unstructured outputs." Keep it concise.
tara: also grep for `tool_call` across /snippets and /docs and convert occurrences to the compat phrasing in small PRs. ops wants explicit note when we change visible examples.
rebecca: will run grep and either update in this PR or open tiny follow-ups and link them. PR title will be plain: "docs: compact invoke envelopes + appendix + migration linkfix" (no emojis).
docs-ci: queued CI run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/3344556677
nate: i'll review after standup. if it's small and tests pass, one approval + CI green is fine to merge.
rebecca: thanks team  I'll include the changelog blurb and request reviews from @nate and @oli.
oli: LGTM pending the anchor fix and the grep pass.
docs-ci: PR updated: link fix applied, snippets updated, changelog added, CI lint included.
